Two arms/two hands only. She carries a LARGE orange carved pumpkin lantern cauldron hanging from a short iron handle in her near hand, held in front to the LEFT, from waist to knee. Other hand raises a short plain wooden wand. Full body always faces LEFT in strict lateral side scrolling combat view. NO front-facing poses. Distinct commanding silhouette, about twice ordinary witch size in game. The hollow lantern has a small cyan-yellow lit face, but NO external glow, projectiles, beams, sparks, circles or detached effects. Crisp ink edges and shaded cartoon painted volume matching reference. Output EXACTLY 4 columns x4 rows, 16 isolated full-body poses in equal square cells, transparent background, no lines/text/numbers, ample transparent gutters, constant character proportions and foot baseline in each cell. Row1: four breathing idle frames, lantern sway. Row2: four anticipation frames raising wand high while lifting lantern slightly, crouching to brace. Row3: four releasing attack frames, wand POINTING LEFT horizontally, lantern steady, bare wand tip visible, NO magic painted on. Row4: four physical hit reactions: flinch, shoulders recoil, gritted teeth, recovering. Maintain design, clothes and exactly two arms in every frame; no frame touching any border. Canvas 1536x1536 or larger square.
